name: @coolma/muya
description: Muya markdown editor — Memocast's editor core with rune / echo extensions

scripts.test: echo "see Memocast tests/unit/echo and tests/unit/rune for runtime contract tests" && exit 0
scripts.status: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const p=require('path');try{const links=cp.execSync('yarn link --list',{cwd:__dirname}).toString().trim();console.log('yarn link registry:');console.log(links||'(empty)')}catch(e){console.log('yarn link --list not supported on this version')}console.log('\nlib/ size:');let n=0;function w(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(p.join(d||__dirname,'lib'),{withFileTypes:true})){if(f.isDirectory())w(p.join(d||__dirname,'lib',f.name));else n++}}w();console.log(' ',n,'files')"
